Take the 6,513 housing units in Lemont and 25.3 percent of them are older than 1980, with a median build year of 1994. 9.1 percent go back to 1939 or earlier. On stock that age the prep is the job and the paint is the easy part.

Behind the housing are 5,524 owner households and 810 renter households, 87.2 percent owner occupied. Of the units themselves, 11.2 percent are in buildings of two or more, 12.6 percent share a party wall as townhomes or rowhouses, and 76.2 percent stand on their own at a median 7.3 rooms. Median home value is $447,800.

Lemont is in the top four of the 54 suburbs and towns covered here for the highest median home value ($447,800) and the newest housing stock overall (25.3 percent built before 1980).

Three figures put Lemont a long way from the average of the 76 places on this site: housing built before 1970 at 17.9 percent against a 56.9 percent average, townhomes and rowhouses at 12.6 percent against a 7.5 percent average and housing in buildings of two or more at 11.2 percent against a 29 percent average.

Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, 2019-2023 (tables B25003, B25024, B25034, B25035, B25077). Every dollar figure on this page is a published Census estimate of what homes in the area are worth. None of it is a price for work.

How the age of the stock changes the work here

On housing built around 1994, the original finish was sprayed once at the factory or once on site and has never been touched. That gives a very consistent surface and a very unforgiving one: it fails all at once across a whole elevation rather than in patches, so the work is scheduled by elevation rather than by room. With 12.6 percent of units attached, a lot of jobs here come with a board and a color scheme already decided. That is a different kind of work: exact matching, a fixed sequence, and several identical elevations in a row.

The lines a quote for Lemont needs to show

  • Finish level. With a median home value of $447,800, the finish standard people expect here is higher than the standard a fast quote is priced at. Worth agreeing before rather than after.
  • Distance, stated. Lemont is 10.4 straight-line miles from the shop. Travel to Lemont is not a hidden line item on this site and it should not be one on a written quote either.
  • Trim, counted separately. At a median of 7.3 rooms, casing, baseboard and doors are the half of an interior that actually varies. A single number for the whole house hides it.
  • Whole elevations. 76.2 percent of the housing is detached, so an exterior here is four sides and a garage rather than one face of a shared building.

What the housing here is likely made of

Most of it is frame with a masonry front elevation and siding on the other three, cedar or composite trim boards, and enough two story wall in Lemont that the ladder plan matters as much as the paint plan.

That reading comes from two numbers on this page and nothing else: a median build year of 1994 and a structure split of 76.2 percent detached, 12.6 percent attached and 11.2 percent in buildings of two or more.

Read it as a starting assumption rather than a finding. No public dataset records what the walls in Lemont are made from, so attaching a number to it would mean inventing one. The house itself answers faster than any table can.

Why the town line matters here

Homer Glen is 4.5 miles from Lemont and is the closest comparison there is. It is not a close one. The two differ on prewar share (9.1 percent against 1.3 percent); share of units in buildings of two or more (11.2 percent against 5.5 percent); owner households (5,524 against 7,480).

The 1978 question in Lemont depends on your street

25.3 percent of housing units were built before 1980, the nearest bucket to the 1978 line that the Census publishes, and that is the reading for Lemont. A number that close to half says something about Lemont and nothing at all about your address. The town is split. The answer is at street level.

Neither of the town-wide numbers is your address. They are a median build year of 1994 and 17.9 percent of the housing built before 1970, and both of them describe Lemont.

Pre-1978 homes fall under the federal Renovation, Repair and Painting rule wherever the work disturbs paint. Illinois never took the program over, so EPA runs it here itself. Look up the year your own place went up before a quote gets written: either side of 1978 changes how the area is sealed, how the dust is handled and what the site looks like at the end.

Settle it off the property record before anyone prices the work, rather than after the third number comes in.

Questions

Asked about Lemont

My house in Lemont is not old. Why does the quote still take so long?

Height and area, mostly. Housing here runs to a 1994 median build year, which means two story elevations outside and two story entries and stair walls inside. That is access equipment and setup time rather than paint, and it is the part that gets left out of a fast number. It is worth having it itemized so you can see what you are paying for.

How is an interior price worked out for a house this size?

By trim, mostly. The median home in Lemont runs 7.3 rooms, and rooms bring door casing, window casing and baseboard with them. Wall area is the fast part of an interior job and trim is the slow part, so a quote that gives one number for the whole house is hiding the half of it that actually varies. Ask for the trim separately.

Do you actually come out to Lemont, or is this just a page?

It is 10.4 straight-line miles from the shop in Bridgeview, so it is a genuine drive and the answer depends on the job. A full exterior or a whole interior is worth the trip. One small patch on its own usually is not, and you will be told that rather than quoted a number that quietly covers the travel. Call 708-935-4289 and ask before you plan around it.

Is the $447,800 median home value in Lemont what a job here costs?

No, and the two are unrelated. $447,800 is the Census estimate of what homes in Lemont are worth, and it is on this page because the age and the size of the housing describe the work. No price for painting or remodeling appears anywhere on this site, because no local range has been established that would survive being checked. Every job is quoted after we stand in it.
